scope: Labelled origin supplements for September calendar names whose reviewed history gives no origin.
method: thin151.mjs 09-01 09-31 listed reviewed September histories without origin wording; r159-data.mjs + build-r159.mjs (generated by makebuild.mjs from the round 151 helpers and the O-blocks of rounds 152–159) wrote public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements-r159.js, merged by public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements.js. Lithuanian comparison names in two-stem notes are checked against the LT calendar (lt2check.cjs). Skipped: names whose reviewed history already explains the word (Agris, Agrita, Sidnejs, Vanesa, Girstautas, Rimgaudas), names without a secure base (Vaidis, Vaira group, Spārīte, Guntra, Modris, Gundra, Elmīna, Selita, Regīns, Stenlijs, Daugilė, Kovaldas, Gytė, Bartas, Mirga, Burvilė, Verena, Vydenis, Erdenis, Eisvinas, Sanija, Protenis, Üllar, Ülo group, Lembo, Ago group, Elo, Kaur) and recent EE register names. Rounds 159–162 share writer 1.9.132 and the audit research/namedays/round162-audit.json. Wording follows the 16 November rules (no sources, no Russian attribution).
